author: Spatial
name: glass-orb
description: A thick glass sphere that bends a spinning shape inside it; tap to swap the shape.

author: Spatial
name: crystal
description: A cut gem with real internal bounces and rainbow dispersion, lit by a generated environment.

author: Spatial
name: mirror-floor
description: A glossy reflective disc with a small cube hovering above it that hops when tapped.

author: Spatial
name: portal-card
description: A card that is a window into a small deep room with a spinning shape; tap to light the inside.

author: Spatial
name: outlined-object
description: A toon-shaded capsule with an inked outline that thickens on hover; tap toggles it.

author: Spatial
name: edges-object
description: A dodecahedron drawn as glowing hard edges over a dark body that pulses when tapped.

author: Spatial
name: wireframe-object
description: A geodesic sphere drawn with thick shader wires whose faces fill on hover; tap toggles dashes.

author: Spatial
name: metaballs
description: Lava-lamp blobs that merge and split, speed up on hover and huddle together when tapped.

author: Spatial
name: decal-object
description: A ball you can decorate by tapping it to project star stickers onto its surface.

author: Spatial
name: infinite-grid
description: A crisp shader grid, either a 40 cm measuring tile or a floor that fades into the distance.

author: Spatial
name: positional-audio
description: A small speaker that plays a synthesized blip from its spot in space when tapped.
